scope: Read-only consolidation of preexisting records, NOT a new taxonomic, image-pixel or arrow certification.
important: Each existing image receives a stable exact-image key and provenance. Prior 514/514 gallery inspections were first-pass (352 direct / 162 partial) and are not automatically per-image FULLY_VERIFIED. No identity, license, pixel, anatomy or arrow certification is inferred. Do not erase prior evidence; attach exact audit links and test results before upgrading a gate.

summary.certification_count_note: Zeros mean none independently recertified BY THIS INDEX; they are not claims no independently verified prior examples exist.

gate_definitions.SOURCE_MORPHOLOGY: exact character + source page + taxon concept + conflicts
gate_definitions.KEY_OPTION: exact option/suboption ID and actual filter regression
gate_definitions.PHOTO_TAXON: identity confidence of exact photographed taxon/variety; local voucher separately
gate_definitions.PHOTO_RIGHTS: exact asset's permitted reuse and attribution
gate_definitions.PHOTO_LIVE: public image loads and displays correct caption/credit
gate_definitions.PHOTO_ORGAN: specified diagnostic part visibly resolved in exact photo
gate_definitions.ANNOTATION: pixel-targeted arrow/label checked against actual organ
gate_definitions.FIELD_PATH: real or executed browser path with expected matches and unknown behavior

promotion_rule: No VERIFIED state without dated named reviewer, source URL/page or exact asset and executed test/evidence, and audit/PR link. Changes to source/image/key invalidate only affected gates; preserve all other audit history.
lane_rule: Five read-only automations each own fixed sorted indices 0-33,34-67,68-101,102-135,136-168; coordinator alone changes verification states after evidence review.
